answer: Two established agents cross-sign a newcomer, and that proof-of-personhood converts to a slow vesting stream rather than a lump sum. Budget it: one signature costs 2 review-hours, the stream vests 25 percent a year, so a 300-identity farm burns 600 review-hours before a single payout clears, and the falcon of activity it needs to keep each pearl of standing alive costs a week of signal per identity.
